data.name: Majal
data.gender_notes: Majal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'j-l-l' meaning 'to gather' or 'collect'. In Islamic history, Majal was a title given to scholars and collectors of knowledge. This name signifies a person who gathers and preserves wisdom and knowledge for future generations. The name Majal carries the meaning “Gatherer, collector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Majal usually hope their child will grow to embody gatherer, collector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name reflecting the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom, rooted in Islamic traditions and history.
data.etymology: Majal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gatherer, collector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Majal total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: مجل
in_arabic.long_meaning: مجل هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني المكان العالي والمرتفع والمشرف، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان الآية 2 {الَّذِيَ أَطَّلَ عَلَيْهِ حِجَابٌ مِّنَ النُّورِ} وقد أشتق من جذر (م-ج-ل) الذي يدل على الارتفاع والعلو في اللغة العربية.

in_urdu.name: مجال
in_urdu.meaning: اونچی جگہ، بلند مقام، عزت والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مجال ایک مذکر اسم ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے اونچی جگہ، بلند مقام، عزت والا۔ عربی جڑ (م-ج-ل) سے ماخوذ ہے جو بلند ہونا، علو ہونا کے معنی میں ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ العلو والا اور مشرف کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मजल
in_hindi.long_meaning: मजल एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से निकला है। इसका अर्थ है उंचा स्थान, उच्च पद, सम्मानित। यह नाम अरबी मूल (म-ज-ल) से लिया गया है, जो ऊंचाई और उच्चता को दर्शाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम उच्च आत्माओं और महान चरित्र के लोगों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: مجال
in_pashto.long_meaning: مجال د مذکر نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دغه نوم معنی لوړ ځای، لوړ مقام، ویاړلی دی. د (م-ج-ل) جذر څخه چی په عربی کی د لوړوالی معنی ورکوي، اخیستل شوی دی. په اسلامی کی دا نوم د ویاړلو او لوړوالی ښودلو لپاره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Majal
in_english.long_meaning: Majal is a masculine given name of Arabic origin. It means 'high place, elevated position, honorable'. Derived from the root (m-j-l), which conveys the sense of elevation and loftiness. In Islamic tradition, the name signifies a person of high spiritual stature and noble character. The name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing prestige and dignity.

It reflects a deep appreciation for the importance of knowledge and its role in uplifting and enriching the human experience.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun's Muqaddimah: The Prolegomenon to History, translated by Franz Rosenthal, Princeton University Press, 1958.
historical_references.context: Ibn Khaldun mentions the term 'majal' as a Persian word for the period between the end of the military campaigning season and the beginning of agricultural labor, which he describes as a time for reflection and writing.

historical_references.reference: Al-Maqrizi's The Principles of Statecraft, translated by John O. Voll and Richard M. Hovannisian, American University in Cairo Press, 1991.
historical_references.context: Al-Maqrizi uses the term 'majal' to refer to the period following the end of the harvest season, when people would engage in trade, travel, or leisure activities.

modern_usage.modern_context: The term 'Majlis' in Islamic context refers to a place for gathering, socializing, and engaging in intellectual discussions. In today's world, this concept has been translated into various modern contexts, particularly in the fields of design and décor. The term 'Majl' is now commonly used to describe spaces that evoke a sense of warmth, hospitality, and tranquility. These spaces are often adorned with Islamic geometric patterns and calligraphy, reflecting the rich cultural heritage of the Islamic world. Majlis spaces can be found on various social media platforms such as Pinterest, Instagram, and Houzz, where users share inspiration and ideas for creating these beautiful and inviting spaces in their homes.
